selection_subject: Choose the first owner after BoolRecipe Compare producer coverage, without opening MIR Compare/Branch mutation yet.

candidates.name: SymbolicCompareLoweringCommandPilot
candidates.reason: A symbolic read-only command boundary can name operand, rhs-bound, compare-op, dst-allocation, and branch-target requirements before any BasicBlock mutation or ValueId allocation is moved.

candidates.name: EmitMirCompareNow
candidates.reason: Direct Compare emission would mix BoolRecipe consumption with operand ValueId resolution and destination allocation.

candidates.name: EmitMirCompareAndBranchNow
candidates.reason: Branch emission also needs BasicBlock target ownership and route/lowering integration.

candidates.name: SelectMutationBearingOwnerNow
candidates.reason: Mutation-bearing ownership is a later design boundary; this card only selects a read-only symbolic publication pilot.

candidates.name: ExternalDesignStop
candidates.reason: The safe next slice is non-mutating and keeps all runtime authority claims at zero.

selected_boundary.name: CompareLoweringSymbolicCommandSnapshotV1
selected_boundary.output: read-only symbolic compare lowering command snapshot
